parameters.query:
SELECT session_id, current_step, answers, completed, false AS is_new_session
FROM booking_sessions
WHERE session_id = '{{ $json.sessionId }}'
UNION ALL
SELECT '{{ $json.sessionId }}', 0, '{}'::jsonb, false, true AS is_new_session
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM booking_sessions WHERE session_id = '{{ $json.sessionId }}')
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE booking_sessions
SET current_step = {{ $json.current_step }},
    answers = jsonb_set(answers, '{"{{ $json.answered_field_name }}"}', to_jsonb('{{ $json.answered_value }}'::text))
WHERE session_id = '{{ $json.session_id }}'
RETURNING session_id, current_step, answers;

UPDATE booking_sessions
SET current_step = {{ $json.current_step }},
    answers = jsonb_set(answers, '{"{{ $json.answered_field_name }}"}', to_jsonb('{{ $json.answered_value }}'::text)),
    completed = true
WHERE session_id = '{{ $json.session_id }}'
RETURNING session_id, answers;

SELECT full_name, total_past_appointments, total_no_shows
FROM patients
WHERE full_name ILIKE '%{{ $json.answers.patient_name }}%'
LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO appointments (
    session_id, patient_name, phone, doctor_name, appointment_date,
    appointment_time, reason_for_visit, risk_score, risk_reasoning
)
VALUES (
    '{{ $json.session_id }}',
    '{{ $json.patient_name }}',
    '{{ $json.phone }}',
    '{{ $json.doctor_name }}',
    '{{ $json.appointment_date }}',
    '{{ $json.appointment_time }}',
    '{{ $json.reason_for_visit }}',
    '{{ $json.risk_level }}',
    '{{ $json.risk_reasoning }}'
)
RETURNING id, patient_name, risk_score;
